99.label: Bus Route 99 disruption
99.description: Loss derived from Siyan Tao's OSM-Dijkstra walking-network model. When bus route 99 is removed, the AI score for every affected 100 m grid cell is recomputed; values shown here are averaged from grid cells back up to the LSOA.
